ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Query of MachineGUID
ruleDefinitions.description: Use of reg to get MachineGuid information

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\reg\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Cryptography.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/v\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*MachineGuid.*")))
